name: flexi-day-workspace
description: Local workspace wrapper for the three Flexi Day repos (not a published package, not version-controlled). Scripts delegate into each sub-repo via `npm --prefix`.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix ./flexi-day install && npm --prefix ./flexi-day-be install && npm --prefix ./flexi-day-emails install
scripts.db:up: docker start flexi-day-pg 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name flexi-day-pg -p 5432:5432 -e POSTGRES_USER=$USER -e POSTGRES_DB=flexi-day -e POSTGRES_HOST_AUTH_METHOD=trust postgres:15
scripts.stack:up: npm run db:migrate && (npm run dev:be & npm run dev:fe & wait)
